description: Are you looking for a rugged, practical, and dependable military styled backpack to carry your essentials day in and day out? Look no further! Our Jumbo Vintage Canvas Backpack provides ample storage space for a variety of needs. The canvas bag has a 28L capacity, and measures 18 inch x 13.5 inch x 7 inch overall. The main zipper compartment is ideal for carrying a laptop, books, folders, and other everyday carry items. Durable Material Construction: Consisting of heavy-duty cotton canvas, these rucksacks are built tough and will withstand consistent use. The metal hardware and leather zipper pulls (webbed straps for Woodland Camo) provide additional strength while emulating a time-less look and feel. Spacious Storage Compartments: In addition to the main rear compartment, these military backpacks contain 3 additional zipper compartments. The 2 middle compartments are great for storing laptop accessories, small notepads, and writing utensils, while the top pocket compartment is convenient for securing headphones, loose change, and small items. Comfortable Padding: The laptop bag features a padded back and padded shoulder straps for a more comfortable carry. The shoulder straps are also adjustable, allowing you to adjust the backpack when needed. Utility at the Forefront: There’s a built-in top grab handle for quick and easy handling, especially when you’re on the go. These travel bags also include 2 elastic side pouches that are prefect for carrying water bottles. Each side also has an upper hold-down strap used for securing longer items, such as a rolled up playmat, tripod, or flashlight. Top Grade Canvas: Made from Rothco’s rugged, durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of premium canvas bags and packs.
